With high speed movement and spin-stealing abilities, it is a good buy.

== Overall ==
'''Advance Striker''' as a whole is a very well designed and constructed Beyblade. Its Attack Ring does has effective Upper Attack in right spin, but it is outclassed by the two most popular choices in the format (Circle Upper, Samurai Upper). This disparity prevents it from being used in most competitive play as an Upper Attack AR unless playing within Restricted HMS tournament Rules. Its real strength lies in its [[Force Smash]] ability and left-spin Upper Attack, two Attack styles which are far less populated. Force Smash ARs are infrequent, contrary to Circle Upper and Samurai Upper, which are only effective [[Upper Attack]]ers in right spin.

The RC Metal Flat Core is a very useful part to own. The low height, high speed and excellent durability make it a very good option for all Attack combos. Its features lend themselves well to Smash Attack customizations in a field overpopulated with [[Upper Attack]] Combos. '''Overall this is a good buy for [[Heavy Metal System|HMS]], and serious players and [[Attack]] Beyblade enthusiasts should have one in their collection.'''

== Bit Protector (BP): Aero Knight Emblem ==
The Bit Protector of this Beyblade is Aero Knight emblem. The design is a knight head with what it seems like to be a feather sticking out from its helmet to represent the "air" feature of the beyblade.

==Attack Ring: Knight Crusher==

* '''Weight:''' 19 grams

The attack ring has two metal parts protruding from the plastic, in both left and right spin there are major contact points which make the attacking ring fairly useless in all areas, this means it could be a potential attack type attack ring but it is obviously outclassed by attack rings such as Samurai Upper, Circle Upper, and Advance Survivor making this attack ring one of the more useless ones for competitive play. When the attack ring spins left there are major recoil points from the plastic part covering the metal, this plastic makes it have a lot of recoil, using it in left spin could also lead to wearing of the plastic due to the exposure of it. Right spin features the metal being a contact point, but the contact point is so sudden that it will only lead to recoil to itself making it not very useful.

==Weight Disk: Circle Wide==
*'''Weight: '''14 grams
Circle Wide is the largest but also the lighter of the three original HMS Weight Disks. It forms a perfect circle and the distribution of its mass is favourable to endurance and attack combos. It is benefit to endurance combos, as the remote mass axis increases the spin velocity. For attack combos, its light weight increases the speed and movement of the combo and places the weight on the projections of the Ring.

=== Mold Variation ===
A heavier Circle Wide is included with the [[Takara]] version of [[Draciel MS]]. The increase weight varies between 0.5 g and 0.7 g and its effects are beneficial: This molding is preferred to the original in all circumstances.

The slots for sliding the metal disc on the running core are slightly smaller on the [[Sonokong]] versions Circle Heavy, Circle Balance and Circle Wide as those of Takara and [[Hasbro]]. Taking into account the normal variations of the size of the weight disks , it means that the Sonokong Discs would fit more easily on the running core or will be incompatible.

=== Use In [[Stamina|Endurance]] Combo ===
AR: [[Attack Ring - Advance Survivor|Advance Survivor]] ([[Advance Eterner]])

WD: Circle Wide

RC: [[Running Core - Bearing Core|Bearing Core]] ([[Wolborg MS]])

=== Use in [[Attack]] Combo ===
AR: [[Attack Ring - Slash Upper|Slash Upper]] ([[Slash Riger MS]])

WD: Circle Wide

RC: Grip Flat Core ([[Dragoon MS]])

==Running Core: Aero Core & Aero Wing==

=== Aero Core ===

* '''Weight:''' 3 grams

The Aero Core is one of the tallest running cores from the HMS series coming in at a height of about 3.3 centimeters. The running core easily looks like an equivalent of 230 from the MFB series, but it certainly does not perform as well as one would expect it to, this is because of the compact style of HMS beyblades, 230 works with MFB because they have a lot less gravitational torque from their big diameter, while HMS usually tend to have very high gravitational torque since they have a significantly lower diameter, this causes the beyblade to lose its balance a lot quicker versus the MFB beyblade since it has much less centrifugal acceleration than the MFB bey, and since everything accelerates downward at the same speed the bey (HMS in this case) will fall quicker due to its light mass and small diameter nature because it has less forces acting on it that keep the beyblade up right.

=== Aero Wing ===

* '''Weight:''' 6 grams

The Aero Wing is just a gimmick which was previously present on a plastic beyblade called Trypio, due to the gimmicks being exactly the same, even the fact that you can launch the "helicopter" like disks by themselves to make them fly, it was a clear inspiration to the creation of Aero Knight. Competitive wise, this part is horrible because it slows down the beyblade dramatically, its air resistance is horrible which is why it forces Aero Knight MS to slow down so drastically when in battle. Another reason for it making the performance a lot worse is because if a beyblade manages to get under the Aero Wing then it will just scrape the stadium floor making it loose a lot of its spin and most likely all of its balance for the rest of the battle.

{{Beyblade Infobox |Image=DEMS4.jpg |JPName=デスガーゴイル{{Ruby|MS|メタルスクリーム}} |RomajiName=Desu Gāgoiru Metaru Sukurīmu |AKA=Death Gargoyle MS (Japanese)
Death Gargoyle Metal Scream (Japanese)
Dark Gargoyle MS (manga, English)
Dark Effigy ([[Hasbro]]) |ProductCode=MA-04 |Type=Balance |Price= |System=Hard Metal System |Series=New Generation Custom Beigoma - Beyblade: HMS Heavy Metal Battle |ReleaseJP=January 2004 |ReleaseEN= |BitProtector=Gargoyle Emblem |AttackRing=Circle Upper |WeightDisk=Circle Heavy |RunningCore=Metal Change Core |Owner=[[Miguel (Barthez Battalion)|Miguel]] (manga) |AppearAnime= |AppearManga= }}'''Dark Gargoyle MS''', known as {{Translation|'''Death Gargoyle MS'''|デスガーゴイル{{Ruby|MS|メタルスクリーム}}|Desu Gāgoiru Metaru Sukurīmu}} in Japan, is a Balance Type [[Hard Metal System]] Beyblade. It is the successor to [[Dark Gargoyle]] in the toyline. ==Bit Protector : Gargoyle Emblem== The Bit Protector of this Beyblade is Gargoyle Emblem. It is the first mold version of Bit Protectors. ==Attack Ring : Circle Upper== * '''Weight:''' 20 grams Circle Upper is one of the most useful ARs available. This usefulness is due to the unique shape of its Metal Frame; it is an almost perfect circle shape that completely surrounds the outside of the AR, with two large, deep slopes on either side that are used for Upper Attack. Although it has some Smash Attack ability and Force Smash in left spin, these traits are negligible when compared to the effectiveness of its Upper Attack. Because of the round shape of Circle Upper, many hits will not be incredibly effective against it. There are very few points of contact for another AR to latch onto during a hit, generally causing the Beyblade attacking Circle Upper to take the majority of the damage. Circle Upper is the second widest HMS AR available (The widest being Samurai Changer MS's Samurai Upper) Because of this, it has one of the widest attack range of all HMS ARs. While not as much of an advantage in Tornado Balance Type S, in wider stadiums where making early contact is crucial, the extra range can mean the difference between winning or losing. A point of note is the weight distribution on Circle Upper; because there is no metal near the center, only along the outside rim, all of the weight is focused there. This will generally lead to an AR with poor balance, and placing it on a tall RC will cause wobbling. However, there are two ways to negate this disadvantage: * The most popular combos with Circle Upper generally use very low RCs, e.g. Dragoon MS's Grip Flat Core, so the poor balance is generally not an issue. * There are combos you can build where this poor balance can be used as an advantage, which is discussed on this page. In contrast to the Metal Frame, the ABS Caul mostly serves to be a cradle for the Bit Protector. Most of the contact with the opposing Beyblade will be with the Metal Frame, another one of Circle Upper's great advantages. Circle Upper has very few disadvantages and many advantages, and this is why it is one of the most-used ARs of all time. ==='''Mould Differences'''=== There was a change made to the mould of Circle Upper's Metal Frame. The change was first employed at the release of HMS Random Booster ACT 3, and was also released byHasbro. The second mold has a Metal Frame that is reinforced along the entire Upper Attack slope. The result is that it is significantly thicker and weighs more. This does alter the balance so that it is even more prone to wobbling. The previous mould is lighter and has better Survival capability. These moulds are referred to as "first mould" and "second mould", respectively. You can select one or the other depending on your strategy. ===Use in Upper Attack Customization=== Death Gargoyle MS's Circle Upper and Samurai Changer MS's Samurai Upper dominated as the top choice ARs for Attack-types. This style of combo can be used effectively to defeat Survival types such as Wolborg MS in many stadiums. * '''AR:''' Circle Upper (Death Gargoyle MS) * '''WD:''' Circle Wide * '''RC:''' Grip Flat Core (Ultimate Version) (Dragoon MS UV) ==='''Use in Wobbling Customization'''=== While wobbling is a strategy that is often difficult to implement effectively, this is one of the few ARs that makes it a viable strategy. You can combine it with a Survival-type core to beat other Survival-types. The Smash Attack gained from Wobbling, along with Circle Upper's innate Upper Attack and the Survival capabilities of its round shape make this a good strategy to attempt. * '''AR:''' Circle Upper (Death Gargoyle MS)* * '''WD:''' Circle Wide * '''RC:''' Bearing Core (Wolborg MS) *''Select the first mould Circle Upper for more Survival ability, or the second mould for more Attack ability.'' ==='''Shared Metal Frame'''=== The second mould of Circle Upper's Metal Frame is the same Metal Frame used in Samurai Changer MS. ==Weight Disk: Circle Heavy== '''Circle Heavy''' is a Weight Disk that, as its name suggests, features a circular design and a heavy weight. Due to its high Outward Weight Distribution (OWD), '''Circle Heavy''' excels in both Attack and Defense combinations. '''Circle Heavy''' can be used when the much rarer CWD Defense Ring and CWD God Ring Weight Disks are unavailable. ==Running Core: Metal Change Core== * '''Weight:''' 3 grams Metal Change Core has its roots early in the life of Beyblade, with the first incarnation being Driger S's SG Metal Change Base. Since then, the tip was also used in Driger V2 andGigars, but the Metal Change Core has the best implementation of it to date. The design of the Metal Change Core is that there is a small metal tip on the end. At the very center of the tip it comes to a point, and all of the area of the tip surrounding the point is broad and flat. If the Beyblade is level to the angle of the stadium, it stands on the sharp tip and is stationary (Survival mode). If the Beyblade is on an angle to the stadium, it will stand on the broad portion of the tip and move quickly around the stadium (Attack mode). Metal Change Core's Attack mode is about the same speed as Advance Striker's Metal Flat Core. Another great advantage of Metal Change Core is its size. Its low height compliments the function of Circle Upper very well by allowing it to get under the opposing Beyblade and perform Upper Attack. ===Using Metal Change Core With Sliding Shoot=== When you shoot Metal Change Core using Sliding Shoot, the Beyblade will move in a flower pattern through the center of the stadium, switching between Attack and Survival. This works very well for beating Beyblades that spend most of their time at the center of the stadium. ===Use in Compact Customization=== Metal Change Core is a short, small part with both the sharpest tip available and the ability to move very quickly for Attack-mode. This makes it the perfect candidate for a Compact combo. * '''AR:''' Metal Ape (Magical Ape MS) * '''WD:''' CWD Defense Ring (Sea Dragon) * '''RC:''' Metal Change Core (Death Gargoyle MS) ===Use in Upper Attack Customization=== Upper Attack combos work very well with high spin velocity parts. The same attributes that make this part a perfect candidate for Compact customization also apply to Upper Attack. Although Death Gargoyle MS uncustomized can work fine for this, you can also try this combo for something with more Survival and spin velocity. * '''AR:''' Advance Attacker (Advance Striker) * '''WD:''' CWD Defense Ring (Sea Dragon) * '''RC:''' Metal Change Core (Death Gargoyle MS) ==Other Versions:== *'''Death Gargoyle MS (RED) : '''A red recoulour was released in [[HMS Random Booster Act 2]]. *'''Death Gargoyle MS (Purple) : '''A purple recolour was released in [[HMS Random Booster Act 3]]. *'''Death Gargoyle (Light Blue) : '''A light blue recolour was released in [[HMS Random Booster Act 3]]. ==Gallery== ====Death Gar

== Changement de nom ==
Death Gargoyle MS a été renommée Dark Effigy MS par Hasbro.

== Protecteur spectral (PS) : Emblème du Gargoyle ==
Le Protecteur spectral de cette toupie est l’emblème du Gargoyle et provient du premier moulage des protecteurs.

== Anneau d’attaque (AA) : Circle Upper ==
* '''Poids :''' 20 grammes
Le Circle Upper est l’un des AA les plus utiles. Cette utilité est dérivée de la forme unique du cadre de métal, lequel délimite l’Anneau d’un cercle presque parfait ayant deux grandes pentes opposées servant aux attaques ascendantes. Il possède également une certaine puissance latérale et descendante en rotation antihoraire, mais celle-ci est négligeable en comparaison à la force de ses ascendantes.

La forme circulaire de Circle Upper a aussi pour avantage de réduire l’efficacité des coups portés contre lui : il n’y a que très peu de points de contact sur l’anneau auxquels les autres toupies peuvent s’accrocher, ayant comme conséquence que ces toupies sont celles qui subissent la majorité des dommages. Cet Anneau est le plus large du HMS après le Samurai Upper (Samurai Changer MS) et donc, possède presque la meilleure portée d’attaque. Cette qualité présente peu d’avantages dans une arène Tornado Balance Type S, mais dans les arènes plus grandes, où frapper l’adversaire tôt dans le match est crucial, elle peut se prouver être la différence entre gagner ou perdre.

Caractéristique notable du Circle Upper est la distribution de sa masse : comme son centre est vide de métal, le cadre étant situé en bordure de l’anneau, tout son poids est concentré sur sa circonférence. Cela veut dire que l’équilibre du Circle Upper fait défaut et que de l’utiliser conjointement à un grand Gyrostat fera osciller la toupie. Il existe par contre deux façons de pallier ce désavantage :
* Les combinaisons les plus populaires utilisant le Circle Upper ont souvent de petits GS (le Grip Flat Core, par exemple), et dans ces cas, le manque d’équilibre n’est pas problématique.

* Certaines combinaisons, décrites dans cet article, sont construites sur ce mauvais équilibre.
Dernier des impressionnants avantages du Circle Upper est qu’à l’inverse du cadre de métal, la cale de plastique n’est que très peu exposée aux attaques des toupies adverses et sert principalement à loger le Protecteur spectral.

Cet AA a beaucoup d’avantages et très peu de désavantages et c’est pourquoi il est l’un des AA les plus utilisés du HMS.

=== '''Moulages''' ===
Un nouveau moule a été utilisé pour produire le cadre de métal du Circle Upper des toupies Takara à partir du HMS Random Booster ACT 3 et des toupies Hasbro. Ce nouveau moulage est renforcé sur toute la longueur de la pente d’attaque ascendante et donc, est plus épais et plus lourd que le précédent et l’équilibre de la toupie en est ainsi plus sévèrement affecté. Le premier moulage est plus léger et a une meilleure endurance. On réfère à ces moulages en tant que « premier moulage » et « deuxième moulage », suivant la chronologie. L’un ou l’autre peut être utilisé selon la stratégie employée.

=== '''Utilisation dans une combinaison de type Attaque ascendante''' ===
Le Circle Upper (Death Gargoyle MS) et le Samurai Upper (Samurai Changer MS) sont les choix dominant d’AA des combinaisons d’Attaque. Ces combinaisons sont efficaces pour vaincre les toupies d’endurance comme Wolborg MS dans différentes arènes.
* '''AA :''' Circle Upper (Death Gargoyle MS)
* '''DM :''' Circle Wide
* '''GS :''' Grip Flat Core (Ultimate Version) (Dragoon MSUV)

=== '''Utilisation dans une combinaison de type Oscillation''' ===
Le Circle Upper est l’un des seuls Anneaux à faire de ce type de combinaisons généralement difficile à utiliser un choix valable en tournoi. Avec un GS d’endurance, cette combinaison peut vaincre d’autres toupies d’endurance. Les attaques latérales causées par l’oscillation unies aux attaques ascendantes et à l’endurance naturelles du Circle Upper font de cette combinaison une bonne tactique à essayer.
* '''AA :''' Circle Upper (Death Gargoyle MS)*
* '''DM :''' Circle Wide
* '''GS :''' Bearing Core (Wolborg MS)
<nowiki>*</nowiki>''Pour une meilleure endurance, utilisez le premier moulage de Circle Upper; pour une meilleure attaque, le deuxième.''

=== '''Cadre de métal partagé''' ===
Le deuxième moulage du Circle Upper est réutilisé sur la toupie Samurai Changer MS.

== Disque de métal (DM) : Circle Heavy ==
* '''Poids :''' ~16 grammes
Circle Heavy est le plus lourd et le plus dense des trois Disques HMS originaux. Il est orné de huit petits clous ronds dispersés également sur sa circonférence. Sa lourde masse centrée lui accorde une défense considérable, quoique surclassée, capable d’acceptablement remplacer les DMM (17 g) Defense Ring (Sea Dragon) et God Ring (Shining God MS), lesquels sont respectivement plus lourd et meilleur à absorber les chocs. Sa lourdeur offre également un plus grand potentiel de vélocité, une caractéristique essentielle aux combinaisons d’attaques ascendantes, puisqu’elle augmente la force rotationnelle d’une toupie et réduit son recul au contact et donc, augmente les chances de soulever les toupies adverses et à l’inverse, diminue celles d’être affaissé.

Le format compact du Circle Heavy laisse le dessous des Anneaux d’attaque exposé, ce qui est idéal pour les combinaisons d’attaques descendantes, lesquelles peuvent ainsi utiliser le plein potentiel des pentes et des protubérances situées sous leur Anneau d’attaque.

En tout et pour tout, le Circle Heavy partage nombre de ses qualités avec le DMM (17 g) Defense Ring, dont sa forme, son poids et la distribution de sa masse. Même si ce dernier est préférable, Circle Heavy demeure un choix de remplacement valable, surtout pour les combinaisons à budget limité.

=== '''Moulages''' ===

==== Moulages Sonokong ====
Les encoches servant à glisser le Disque de métal sur le Gyrostat sont légèrement plus petites sur les moulages Sonokong du Circle Heavy, Circle Balance et Circle Wide que sur ceux de Takara et d’Hasbro. Prenant en compte les variations normales de la grosseur des pièces, cela veut dire que les Disques Sonokong pourraient s’insérer plus difficilement sur les Gyrostats, ou bien ne pas pouvoir du tout.

=== '''Utilisation dans une combinaison de type Défense''' ===
* '''AA :''' Samurai Upper (Samurai Changer MS)
* '''DM :''' Circle Heavy
* '''GS :''' Bearing Core 2 (Jiraiya MS)

=== '''Utilisation dans une combinaison de type Attaque ascendante''' ===
* '''AA :''' Circle Upper (Death Gargoyle MS)
* '''DM :''' Circle Heavy
* '''GS :''' Grip Flat Core (Ultimate Version) (Dragoon MSUV)

=== '''Utilisation dans une combinaison de type Attaque descendante''' ===
* '''AA :''' Advance Attacker (Force Smash Mode) (Advance Striker)
* '''DM :''' Circle Heavy
* '''GS :''' Tornado Change Core (Dark Leopard MS)/Manual Change Core (Dranzer MS)

Le Metal Change a ses racines profondément ancrées dans le Beyblade, sa première incarnation étant la Base SG Metal Change du Driger S. Depuis, cette pointe a été réutilisée sur les Bases du Driger V2 et du Gigars, mais la version du Death Gargoyle MS est la meilleure à ce jour.

|Name = Death Gargoyle MS}}Death Gargoyle MS fu rilasciato dalla Hasbro come Dark Effigy MS.

== Bit Power o Bit Protector (BP): Gargoyle Emblem ==
Il Bit Protector di questo Beyblade è l'emblema di Gargoyle. E' la prima versione di stampo dei Bit Protectors.

== Anello d'Attacco o Attack Ring (AR): Circle Upper ==
* '''Peso:''' 20 g
Il Circle Upper è uno degli AR piu' utili disponibili. Questa utilità è dovuta alla particolare forma del suo Metal Frame, è una forma circolare quasi perfetta che circonda completamente l'esterno dell'AR, con due grandi pendenze profonde su entrambi i lati che sono utilizzate per Upper Attack. Anche se ha alcune capacità di Smash Attack e Force Smash in rotazione a sinistra, questi tratti sono trascurabili rispetto all'efficacia del suo Upper Attack.

A causa della forma circolare del Circle Upper, molti colpi non saranno molto efficaci contro di essa. Ci sono pochi punti di contatto per un altro AR per agganciarsi durante un colpo, causando generalmente la maggio parte dei danni al Beyblade che attacca il Circle Upper.

Il Circle Upper è il secondo AR HMS più ampio disponibile (Il più ampio è il Samurai Upper di Samurai Changer MS) A causa di questo, esso ha una delle maggiori gittate di attacco di tutti gli AR HMS. Anche se non è un gran vantaggio nel Tornado Balance Type S, in stadi più ampi dove si hanno brevi contatti è fondamentale, la gittata extra può fare la differenza tra vincere o perdere.

Un punto di nota è la distribuzione del peso sul Circle Upper; perché non c'è metallo vicino al centro, solo lungo il bordo esterno, tutto il peso è focalizzato lì. Questo in genere porta ad un AR con scarso equilibrio, e l'immissione su un RC alto provoca oscillazioni. Tuttavia, ci sono due modi per negare questo inconveniente:
* Le combo più popolari con Circle Upper usano generalmente RC molto bassi, ad esempio il Grip Flat Core di Dragoon MS, così lo scarso equilibrio non è generalmente un problema.

* Ci sono combo che si possono costruire dove questo scarso equilibrio può essere usato come un vantaggio, di cui si parla in questa pagina.
In contrasto con la struttura in metallo, la ABS Caul per lo più serve per essere una culla per il Bit Protector. La maggior parte del contatto con il Beyblade avversario sarà con la struttura in metallo, un altro dei grandi vantaggi del Circle Upper.

Circle Upper ha pochi svantaggi e molti vantaggi, e questo è il motivo per cui è uno degli AR più utilizzati di tutti i tempi.

=== '''Differenze delle versioni di stampo''' ===
Ci fu un cambiamento di versione di stampo del Metal Frame del Circle Upper. Il cambiamento è stato impiegato con l'uscita dell'HMS Random Booster ACT 3, e fu rilasciato anche dalla Hasbro. Il secondo stampo ha una struttura in metallo che è rinforzata lungo tutto il pendio dell'Upper Attack. Il risultato è che l'AR è significativamente più spesso e pesa di più. Ciò altera l'equilibrio in modo che sia ancora più incline all'oscillazione. Lo stampo precedente è più leggero e ha una migliore capacità di durata. Questi stampi sono indicati come "primo stampo" e "secondo stampo", rispettivamente. È possibile selezionare uno o l'altro a seconda della strategia.

=== '''Utilizzo in combinazioni Upper Attack''' ===
Il Circle Upper di Death Gargoyle MS e il Samurai Upper di Samurai Changer MS sono la scelta migliore nel campo dei bey di attacco. Questo tipo di combo lo si utilizza efficacemente per sconfiggere bey di durata come Wolborg MS in molti stadi.
* '''AR:''' Circle Upper (Death Gargoyle MS)
* '''WD:''' Circle Wide
* '''RC:''' Grip Flat Core Ultimate Mode (Dragoon MS UV)

=== '''Utilizzo in combinazioni Wobbling''' ===
Il wobbling è una strategia spesso difficile da attuare efficacemente, questo è uno dei pochi AR che lo rende una strategia percorribile. Si può combinare con un RC di durataper battere altri bey di durata. Lo Smash Attack ottenuto da; Wobbling, insieme all'innato Upper Attack del Circle Upper e le capacità di sopravvivenza della sua forma arrotondata fanno di questa una buona strategia da tentare.
* '''AR:''' Circle Upper (Death Gargoyle MS)*
* '''WD:''' Circle Wide
* '''RC:''' Bearing Core (Wolborg MS)
<nowiki>*</nowiki>''Utilizza la prima versione di stampo del Circle Upper per maggiori capacità di durata, o la seconda per maggiori capacità di attacco.''

=== '''Metal Frame condiviso''' ===
La seconda versione di stampo del Metal Frame del Circle Upper è lo stesso Metal Frame usato in Samurai Changer MS.

== Weight Disk (WD): Circle Heavy ==

== Running Core (RC): Metal Change Core ==
* '''Peso:''' 3 g
Il Metal Change Core ha presto le sue radici nella vita del Beyblade, con la prima incarnazione che fu l' SG Metal Change Base di Driger S. Successivamente, la punta fu anche usata in Driger V2 e Gigars, ma il Metal Change Core ha la migliore attuazione di esso fino ad oggi.

il design del Metal Change Core è che vi è una punta metallica sull'estremità. Al centro della punta si ha una protuberanza, e tutta la zona della punta che circonda la protuberanza è larga e piatta. Se il Beyblade è parallelo all'angolo dello stadio, si presenterà sulla punta sharp (Survival mode). Se il Beyblade forma un angolo con lo stadio, si presenterà sulla parte larga della punta per muoversi velocemente intorno allo stadio (Attack mode). La modalità d'attacco del Metal Change Core's Attack ha circa la stessa velocità del Metal Flat Core di Advance Striker.

Un altro grande vantaggio del Metal Change Core è la sua dimensione. L'altezza ridotta permette al Circle Upper di arrivare sotto il Beyblade avversario ed eseguire l'Upper Attack.

=== '''Utilizzare il Metal Change Core con lo Sliding Shoot''' ===
Quando si lancia il Metal Change Core usando lo Sliding Shoot, il Beyblade si muoverà come se percorresse la sagoma di un fiore verso il centro dello stadio, passando daAttack a Survival. Questo funziona molto bene per battere Beyblade che trascorrono la maggior parte del loro tempo al centro dello stadio.

=== '''Utilizzo in combinazioni Compact''' ===
Il Metal Change Core è una parte bassa e piccola con la punta più acuta disponibile e la capacità di muoversi molto velocemente in modalità di attacco. Questo lo rende il candidato perfetto per una combo Compact.
* '''AR:''' Metal Ape (Magical Ape MS)
* '''WD:''' CWD Defense Ring (Sea Dragon)
* '''RC:''' Metal Change Core (Death Gargoyle MS)

=== '''Utilizzo in combinazioni Upper Attack''' ===
Una combo Upper Attack funziona molto bene con parti che forniscono grande velocità di rotazione. Gli stessi attributi che rendono questa parte un candidato perfetto per comboCompact valgono anche per l'Upper Attack. Anche se Death Gargoyle MS non personalizzato va bene per questo, si può anche provare questa combo per avere qualcosa con più durata e velocità di rotazione.
* '''AR:''' Advance Attacker (Advance Striker)
* '''WD:''' CWD Defense Ring (Sea Dragon)
* '''RC:''' Metal Change Core (Death Gargoyle MS)

== Overall ==
Overall this blade is part of the gimmick series and was advertised as such. Hence it is important to take into consideration that it is not a competitive series blade like [[Death Gargoyle MS]] or [[Wolborg MS]] and should be viewed in that light (such as [[Phantom Fox MS]]). Tornado Change Core is the highlight of the blade and is fun to play with. The ease of use would appeal to younger players with no experience with shooting techniques.

Unfortunately the AR and WD of this blade are not nearly as impressive as the RC and reduce the overall appeal factor. As a recommendation this blade should only be purchased by those with an interest to enlarge their HMS collection. ==Bit Protector: Draciel Emblem==

== Anneau d’attaque (AA) : Metal Shield/Metal Defense ==
* '''Poids :''' 17 grammes
Le Metal Defense a une cale de plastique et un cadre de métal presque identiques, chacun ayant quatre pointes en trapèze. Cette pièce est plutôt inutile; elle a beaucoup de recul et très peu de défense par rapport à d’autres Anneaux.

== Disque de métal (DM) : Circle Wide ==
* '''Poids :''' ~14 grammes
Circle Wide est le plus grand, mais aussi le plus léger des trois Disques HMS originaux. Il forme un cercle parfait et la distribution de sa masse est favorable aux combinaisons d’endurance et d’attaques latérales : en endurance, une masse éloignée de l’axe augmente l’inertie et améliore la conservation d’énergie; en attaque latérale, elle accélère les mouvements de Gyrostats offensifs et place le poids sous les protubérances de l’Anneau.

=== '''Moulages''' ===
Un moulage plus lourd du Circle Wide est inclus avec la version Takara du Draciel MS. Cette augmentation varie entre 0,5 g et 0,7 g et ses effets ne sont que positifs : plus grande vitesse, inertie et résistance à la perte de vélocité. Ce moulage est préféré à l’original en toute circonstance, sans exception.

En raison de son poids, ce moulage peut être utilisé dans des combinaisons d’attaques ascendantes, même si d’ordinaire le Circle Wide ne s’y prête pas, sacrifiant de la vélocité au profit de rapidité de mouvement.

==== '''Moulages Sonokong''' ====
Les encoches servant à glisser le Disque de métal sur le Gyrostat sont légèrement plus petites sur les moulages Sonokong du Circle Heavy, Circle Balance et Circle Wide que sur ceux de Takara et d’Hasbro. Prenant en compte les variations normales de la grosseur des pièces, cela veut dire que les Disques Sonokong pourraient s’insérer plus difficilement sur les Gyrostats, ou bien ne pas pouvoir du tout.

=== '''Utilisation dans une combinaison de type Endurance''' ===
* '''AA :''' Advance Survivor (Advance Eterner)
* '''DM :''' Circle Wide
* '''GS :''' Bearing Core (Wolborg MS)

=== '''Utilisation dans une combinaison de type Attaque latérale''' ===
* '''AA :''' Slash Upper (Slash Riger MS)
* '''DM :''' Circle Wide
* '''GS :''' Grip Flat Core (Dragoon MS)

== Gyrostat (GS) : Sharp Core ==
* '''Poids :''' 2 grammes
Ce Gyrostat est la version HMS du SG Sharp et comporte les mêmes faiblesses. Plus grand que la plupart des Gyrostats, il a peu d’équilibre et est facilement renversé. Cette caractéristique est avantageuse pour certaines combinaisons, mais de meilleures options existent pour l’y substituer. Cette pièce est désuète et sans grande utilité.

In the toyline, it is the successor of [[Dragoon MS Ultimate Version]] and is the last form of [[Tyson Granger]]'s Dragoon Beyblades in the [[Original Series]]. It is succeeded by [[Dragoon Storm Wing Xtreme (Takara Tomy)|Dragoon Storm Wing Xtreme]] in the sequel manga series ''[[Bakuten Shoot Beyblade: Rising]]''. ==Bit Protector (BP): Dragoon Emblem == The Bit Protector is composed entirely of white ABS caul plastic and comes with two sticker options: *Dragoon Emblem: A circular sticker which features a stylized tattoo resembling Dragoon's head with the words "DRAGOON" and "Beyblade Metal System" (in a smaller italicized font) written in white beneath it, Behind is a red background. *Dragoon: The sticker depicts Dragoon. ==Attack Ring: Upper Dragon == {{Part|Attack Ring - Upper Dragon}} ==Weight Disk: CWD Chain Attacker== {{Part|Weight Disk - CWD Chain Attacker}} ==Spinning Core: Metal Weight Grip Core == : ''Main article: [[Running Core - Metal Weight Grip Core]]'' The Metal Weight Grip Core is a medium-profile, [[Attack]]-type Running Core featuring a flat, rubber tip and metal weight core. Similar to other classic flat-shaped rubber tips, the tip on this Running Core generates impressive amounts of traction on smooth, dry surfaces such as Beystadium floors. While this RC performs well in Attack-type combat, when compared to the [[Running Core - Grip Flat Core|Grip Flat Core]] and [[Running Core - Grip Flat Core (Ultimate Mode)|Ultimate Grip Flat Core]] (two RCs with extraordinary [[Statistic#Speed|speed]] and [[Statistic#Agility|mobility]]), there is a glaring difference in performance. Inexperienced Bladers will find controlling both Grip Flat Cores difficult. The Metal Weight Grip Core offers a more controllable alternative, due to its three defining factors: the diameter of the tip, the metal weight core, and the tip's hardened rubber. With a smaller diameter, the tip of Metal Weight Grip Core covers a smaller surface area for tighter, shorter movements; the rubber material used for the base is also stiffer than previous rubber tipped RCs; and the metal core gives the RC an overall weight that is 2 to 3 times greater than both Grip Flat Core and Ultimate Grip Flat Core. On the subject of the metal weight core, this component provides a subtle increased to [[Statistic#Stamina|Stamina]]. ==Other Versions == *'''Dragoon MF Fire Red Version:''' Released with Red BP, Attack Ring, and Spin Core *'''Dragoon MF Blue:'''Released in HMS Booster ACT 5 *'''Dragoon MF Black:'''Released in HMS Booster ACT 5 ==Gallery== ===Toyline=== ====Dragoon MF - Original Version==== DragoonMF1.jpg|Dragoon MF DragoonMF2.JPG|Dragoon MF side view DragoonMF3.JPG|Dragoon MF bottom view DragoonMF4.jpg|Upper Dragon DragoonMF5.JPG|Upper Dragon bottom view, Metal Frame pictured DragoonMF6.jpg|CWD Chain Attacker DragoonMF7.jpg|Metal Weight Grip Core ====Dragoon MF - Fire Red Version==== RDragoonMFfrontview.jpg|Front view RDragoonMFbottom.jpg|Bottom view RDragoonMFbottomview2.png|Bottom view 2 ====Dragoon MF - Black Version==== DmY7X1MXoAUthO1.jpg|Front view ===Manga=== DragoonMFManga.jpg|Brief appearance in the final chapter. ==Name in Other Languages== {| border=1 width="100%" class="sortable roundy" style="margin:auto; background: #FFF; border:1px solid #ddf; border-collapse:collapse" |- style="background: #ddf" !width="15%"|Language !width="20%"|Script !width="30%"|Pronunciation !width="35%"|Etymology |- |Japanese |ドラグーンＭＦ

== Protecteur spectral (PS): Emblème du Dragoon ==
Le Protecteur spectral de cette toupie est l’emblème du Dragoon et provient du deuxième moulage des protecteurs.

== Anneau d’attaque (AA): Upper Dragon ==
* Poids : 19 grammes
L’Upper Dragon est utilisé pour ses attaques ascendantes en rotation horaire et latérales en sens antihoraire, l’apparentant au Devil Crusher (Bloody Devil MS) et à l’Upper Fox (Phantom Fox). Ses latérales sont cependant supérieures à celles de ces derniers, en raison de la forme de sa cale de plastique qui, entre autres choses, est munie de petites pointes. En rotation horaire, l’angle des pentes de l’Upper Dragon est clairement conçu pour des attaques ascendantes, mais en comparaison au Devil Crusher, elles sont plus faibles, car la cale de plastique entrave la partie inférieure des pentes.

Pris dans son ensemble, de meilleurs Anneaux existent autant pour des attaques latérales qu’ascendantes.

=== Cadre de métal partagé ===
L’Upper Dragon partage avec le Devil Crusher et l’Upper Fox le même cadre de métal.

=== Utilisation dans une combinaison de type Attaque latérale ===
L’Upper Dragon n’est pas le meilleur choix pour une toupie d’attaque latérale, mais en raison des pointes de métal faisant contact en rotation antihoraire, il demeure une option adéquate en l’absence d’AA tels que Jiraiya Blade (Jiraiya MS).
* '''AA :''' Upper Dragon ('''Dragoon MF''')
* '''DM :''' Circle Wide
* '''GS :''' Grip Flat Core (Ultimate Version) (Dragoon MS UV)

== Disque de métal (DM) : DMM Chain Attacker ==
* Poids : 17 grammes
Le DMM Chain Attacker a une longue portée d’attaque, plus longue même que bien des AA, mais légèrement plus petite que celle du DMM Devil Saucer (Bloody Devil MS). Cette portée est attribuée aux neuf longues pointes adornant sa circonférence. Puisqu’il tourne sur lui-même, l’utilité du Chain Attacker se veut de gruger l’endurance de l’adversaire, mais en pratique, c’est plutôt la toupie qui l’utilise qui subît la majorité des dégâts. Le fait qu’il n’est pas fixe implique que les pointes sont déplacées chaque fois qu’il y a contact et qu’aucun coup ne sera jamais assez puissant. Ce DMM n’est pas valable dans un contexte de compétition.

== Gyrostat (GS) : Metal Weight Grip Core ==
* Poids : 3 grammes
Le Metal Weight Grip Core, avec sa pointe plate en caoutchouc, est sans équivoque destiné aux toupies d’Attaque. Ses caractéristiques force la comparaison aux Gyrostats Grip Flat et Grip Flat (Ultimate Version), tous deux réputés pour leur grande puissance d’attaque, souvent si imprévisible que les nouveaux joueurs peinent à les contrôler. Sur ce dernier point, le Metal Weight Grip est avantagé pour trois raisons: le diamètre de sa pointe, son poids et la dureté du caoutchouc. Sa pointe plus petite se meut moins; son poids est deux ou trois fois plus grand que les Grip Flat et Grip Flat (Ultimate Version); et le caoutchouc est également plus dur que celui de ces derniers.

Ce Gyrostat devrait être pris en considération pour son léger avantage en Endurance en raison de son poids et pour sa hauteur, qui peut être un avantage ou non selon le contexte (contre un attaquant ascendant utilisant le Grip Flat, par exemple).

=== Utilisation dans une combinaison de type Attaque ascendante ===
En utilisant ce GS, vous pouvez créer une version plus contrôlée d’une des combinaisons d’attaque les plus populaires du HMS.
* '''AA :''' Samurai Upper (Samurai Changer MS)
* '''DM :''' CWD Defense Ring (Sea Dragon)
* '''GS :''' Metal Weight Grip Core ('''Dragoon MF''')

== Bit Protector (BP): Dragoon Emblem ==
Il Bit Protector di questo Beyblade è il Dragoon Emblem. E' la seconda versione di stampa dei Bit Protector.

== Anello d' Attacco o Attack Ring (AR): Upper Dragon ==
* Peso: 19 grammi
L'Upper Dragon è usato per l' Upper Attack in rotazione oraria e per lo Smash Attack in senso anti-orario. In questo modo, esso è simile al Bloody Devil MS Devil Crusher e alPhantom Fox MS Upper Fox, ma grazie alla forma del suo ABS Caul lo Smash Attack è più potente in quanto le punte metalliche sono esposte su ogni lato dell' AR Metal Frame. In più, ci sono un pò di piccole punte sull'ABS Caul che aiutano ad avere uno Smash Attack migliore. In rotazione oraria, l'angolo acuto formato dalle alette della Metal Frame dell' Upper Dragon sono chiaramente destinate ad essere usate per l'Upper Attack, ma messe a paragone con il Devil Crusher, il suo Upper Attack è debole poichè le alette sono ostacolate dall' ABS Caul.

Detto tutto ciò, ci sono un gran numero di scelte migliori sia per lo Smash che per l' Upper Attack.

=== '''La condivisione della Metal Frame''' ===
Upper Dragon condivide la stessa Metal Frame di Devil Crusher from Bloody Devil MS, e l' Upper Fox dal Phanotm Fox MS.

=== '''Utilizzato in combo di Smash Attack''' ===
Upper Dragon non è la migliore scelta per lo Smash Attack, ma grazie alle punte di metallo in rotazione anti-oraria,è una soluzione buona rispetto ad altri AR come quando per esempio la Jiraiya Blade di Jiraiya MS non la si ha.
* '''AR:''' Upper Dragon ('''Dragoon MF''')
* '''WD:''' Circle Wide
* '''RC:''' Grip Flat Core (Ultimate Mode) ( Dragoon MS UV)

== Disco Peso o Weight Disk (WD): CWD Chain Attacker ==
* Peso: 17 grammi
CWD Chain Attacker ha un ampio raggio d'azione, in quanto è più grande della maggior parte degli altri AR HMS. Tuttavia,è leggermente più piccolo del Bloody Devil MS CWD Devil Saucer. Il suo grande raggio d'attacco è attribuito alle 9 punte larghe che circondano il suo perimetro. Grazie alla sua libera rotazione , lo scopo del CWD Chain Attacker è quello di abbassare la resistenza del Beyblade avversario, ma in pratica tuttavia, farebbe più danni al Beyblade se fosse fisso e non avesse una rotazione libera. Il fatto che si muove significa che i vari punti d'attacco saranno sempre in movimento quando colpiranno il Beyblade avversario e non creeranno mai un colpo fatale. Questa CWD non è una buona scelta per uso competitivo.

== Running Core (RC): Metal Weight Grip Core ==
* Peso: 3 grammi
La Metal Weight Grip Core è stata realizzata per l' Attacco a causa della sua base piatta e di gomma. A causa di queste proprietà, è spesso paragonata alla Grip Flat Core diDragoon MS ed alla Grip Flat Core (Ultgimate Mode) di Dragoon MS UV. Le RC sia di Dragoon MS che di Dragoon MS UV sono conosciute per le loro proprietà d'attacco sfrenato; alcune volte talmente sfrenato che i Beybladers inesperti non riescono ad avere un buon controllo su di loro. La Metal Weight Grip Core è più controllabile per 3 ragioni: larghezza della punta, peso e compattezza della gomma. Con una punta più larga, la Metal Weight Grip Core ha movimenti più piccoli ed il suo peso è circa 2-3 volte della Grip Flat Core e della Grip Flat Core (Ultimate Mode). La cosa più importante, la gomma utilizzata è più dura rispetto a quella usata per le RC precedenti.

La Metal Weight Grip Core dovrebbe essere considerata per la sua Resistenza; a causa del suo peso (la sua altezza potrebbe rivelarsi un problema in quanto bisogna stare attenti ai possibili Upper Attack dal basso provenienti da Beyblade più bassi, è bene tenerlo a mente)che può essere utile in certe situazioni.

=== '''Utilizzo in combo Upper Attack''' ===
Udanso questa RC, puoi costruie una variante più controllabile della più popolare combo HMS Attack.
* '''AR:''' Samurai Upper ( Samurai Changer MS)
* '''WD:''' CWD Defense Ring ( Sea Dragon)
* '''RC:''' Metal Weight Grip Core ('''Dragoon MF''')

'''Attack:''' ★ '''Defense:''' ★ '''Endurance:''' ★★★ '''Weight:''' '''14g'''
Circle Wide is part of the Wide series of Weight Disks and as it's name states, it is wide and shaped like a circle. It is quite smooth, resulting in a perfect circle. As with all Wide Weight Disks, Circle Wide focuses it's weight to the outside. Circle Wide mainly has use in Attack, Endurance, and Zombie customizations, and along with Ten Wide, they are mostly used due to being the heaviest of all Wide Weight Disks, with 14 grams in weight. ==Rotation Core: Grip Flat Core==

Approximately 2mm from the base of the tip is a rubber base that can be angled to hit the [[Tornado Ridge]] of the stadium. Doing this will cause the Beyblade to grip onto the stadium with more friction than usual and it will move very quickly. Another advantage is Grip Flat Core's height. Along with [[Dragoon MS UV]]'s Grip Flat Core (Ultimate Version), it is the shortest RC available. This makes it perfect for [[Upper Attack]]. Another attribute it shares with Grip Flat Core (Ultimate Version) is its weight; only 1 gram, the lightest of any RC. This attributes even more to its movement speed. == Protecteur spectral (PS) : Emblème du Dragoon ==
Le protecteur spectral de cette toupie est l’Emblème du Dragoon et provient du premier moulage des protecteurs.

== Anneau d’attaque (AA) : Metal Attacker ==
* '''Poids :''' 14 grammes
Cet Anneau d’attaque a quatre pointes arrondies en métal à découvert. Au moment de sa sortie, ses attaques latérales étaient adéquates, mais ont depuis été surclassées et l’Anneau ne présente plus aucun intérêt compétitif.

== Disque de métal (DM) : Circle Wide ==
* '''Poids :''' ~14 grammes
Circle Wide est le plus grand, mais aussi le plus léger des trois Disques HMS originaux. Il forme un cercle parfait et la distribution de sa masse est favorable aux combinaisons d’endurance et d’attaques latérales : en endurance, une masse éloignée de l’axe augmente l’inertie et améliore la conservation d’énergie; en attaque latérale, elle accélère les mouvements de Gyrostats offensifs et place le poids sous les protubérances de l’Anneau.

=== Moulages ===
Un moulage plus lourd du Circle Wide est inclus avec la version Takara du Draciel MS. Cette augmentation varie entre 0,5 g et 0,7 g et ses effets ne sont que positifs : plus grande vitesse, inertie et résistance à la perte de vélocité. Ce moulage est préféré à l’original en toute circonstance, sans exception.

En raison de son poids, ce moulage peut être utilisé dans des combinaisons d’attaques ascendantes, même si d’ordinaire le Circle Wide ne s’y prête pas, sacrifiant de la vélocité au profit de rapidité de mouvement.

==== Moulages Sonokong ====
Les encoches servant à glisser le Disque de métal sur le Gyrostat sont légèrement plus petites sur les moulages Sonokong du Circle Heavy, Circle Balance et Circle Wide que sur ceux de Takara et d’Hasbro. Prenant en compte les variations normales de la grosseur des pièces, cela veut dire que les Disques Sonokong pourraient s’insérer plus difficilement sur les Gyrostats, ou bien ne pas pouvoir du tout.

=== Utilisation dans une combinaison de type Endurance ===
* '''AA :''' Advance Survivor (Advance Eterner)
* '''DM :''' Circle Wide
* '''GS :''' Bearing Core (Wolborg MS)

=== Utilisation dans une combinaison de type Attaque latérale ===
* '''AA :''' Slash Upper (Slash Riger MS)
* '''DM :''' Circle Wide
* '''GS :''' Grip Flat Core (Dragoon MS)

== Gyrostat (GS) : Grip Flat Core ==
* '''Poids :''' 1 gramme
Le Grip Flat Core est le deuxième Gyrostat d’attaque à être produit, le Flat Core (Gaia Dragoon MS) étant le premier. La comparaison, cependant, s’arrête là : le Grip Flat surpasse le Flat à tous les niveaux.

La pointe de ce GS fait environ 4 mm de diamètre et est constituée d’un caoutchouc très souple. Près de 2 mm au-dessus de cette pointe se trouve une pièce conique – également en caoutchouc – qui permet à la toupie de s’accrocher à la couronne de l’arène lorsqu’elle la frappe en angle, produisant un mouvement beaucoup plus rapide qu’à l’habitude.

Aux atouts du Grip Flat s’ajoute également sa hauteur. Lui et le Grip Flat (Ultimate Version) se partagent non seulement le titre du plus petit Gyrostat offert, une caractéristique parfaite pour les toupies d’attaque ascendante, mais aussi du plus léger : atteignant seulement 1 gramme, il raisonne de sa vitesse. À ce jour, le Grip Flat demeure l’un des meilleurs GS d’attaque.

=== Utilisation dans une combinaison de type Attaque ascendante ===
Ce GS entre dans la création de la combinaison d’attaque la plus populaire du HMS.
* '''AA :''' Samurai Upper (Samurai Changer MS)
* '''DM :''' CWD Defense Ring (Sea Dragon)
* '''GS :''' Grip Flat Core (Dragoon MS)

=== Utilisation dans une combinaison de type Attaque latérale ===
La grande vitesse du Grip Flat peut servir dans une combinaison d’attaque latérale.
* '''AA :''' Slash Upper (Slash Riger MS)
* '''DM :''' Circle Wide
* '''GS :''' Grip Flat Core (Dragoon MS)

Quando venne rilasciata, questa release fu degna di nota per le particolari abilità nelloSmash Attack ma ora è sorpassata. == Weight Disk (WD): Circle Wide == == Running Core (RC): Grip Flat Core == * '''Peso:''' 1 grammo Grip Flat Core fu il secondo RC tipo Attacco ad essere rilasciato con il Flat core di Gaia Dragoon MS. ==Bit Protector: Ape Emblem==
The [[Bit Protector]] of this Beyblade is Ape Emblem. .

==Attack Ring: Metal Ape==

* '''Weight:''' 20 grams

Metal Ape is quite circular in form and the rim of the metal frame surrounds the perimeter of the AR, with only a small amount of the ABS Caul jutting past it. When looking at Metal Ape, its size difference in comparison to other HMS ARs becomes apparent. This is because Metal Ape is the smallest HMS AR ever created, and this along with its centralized weight distribution give it an extremely high spin velocity. This alone immediately makes it one of the top choices in Compact customs, but along with the high spin velocity it also exhibits some Attack attributes through the six protrusions surrounding the metal frame and the edges of the ABS Caul which jut past the metal frame. These attributes are enhanced by its high spin velocity and thus give it enough power to take out lightweight Endurance customs.

While Metal Ape may have inferior Attack abilities compared to its Compact contemporaries, Jiraiya MS's Jiraiya Blade and Einstein MS's Metal Spring, it is more compact than Jiraiya Blade and does not suffer the recoil that Metal Spring is known for.

=== Use in Compact Customization ===
Metal Ape is the most compact AR in the HMS series, and arguably the best for Compact customs. CWD Defense Ring helps maintain its high spin velocity, while simultaneously protecting from Upper Attack, which already gets neutralized by the strong balance this customization has. Using Metal Change Core allows you to choose a moving or stationary movement pattern depending on the situation.

* '''AR:''' Metal Ape ('''Magical Ape MS''')
* '''WD:''' CWD Defense Ring (Sea Dragon)
* '''RC:''' Metal Change Core (Death Gargoyle MS)

==Weight Disk: Circle Heavy==

* '''Weight''': 16.3 grams

'''Circle Heavy''' is a Weight Disk that, as its name suggests, features a circular design and a heavy weight. Due to its high Outward Weight Distribution (OWD), '''Circle Heavy''' excels in both Attack and Defense combinations. '''Circle Heavy''' can be used when the much rarer CWD Defense Ring and CWD God Ring Weight Disks are unavailable.

== Running Core: Flat Core ==
'''Flat Core''' was one of the first Attack-based [[Running Core|Running Cores]] released, but quickly became severely outdated with the release of [[Dragoon MS]] and its [[Running Core - Grip Flat Core|Grip Flat Core]]. It provides decent movement, but there is absolutely no reason to choose it over the numerous other options available now ([[Running Core - Grip Flat Core|Grip Flat Core]], [[Running Core - Grip Flat Core (Ultimate Mode)|Ultimate Grip Flat Core]], [[Running Core - Metal Flat Core|Metal Flat Core]], [[Running Core - Metal Weight Grip Core|Metal Weight Grip Core]], etc).

== Battle Mode ==
Battle Mode is simply Metal Ape, Circle Heavy, and Flat Core put together like a normal HMS Beyblade.

== Gyro Mode ==
As part of the Gimmick Specialty Series, Magical Ape MS must have some sort of gimmick, and Gyro Mode is that gimmick. Gyro Mode makes use of the Gyro Adapter which is made up of an outer shell (or “Armor”, as Takara calls it) that encloses a metal shaft with two metal bearings and a cog which the G-Winder is inserted into for launching, instead of the Dual Shooter. Spin direction is determined by the side the G-Winder is inserted into. The Gyro Adapter has a plastic semi-flat tip and also holds an HMS AR to work as a WD in Gyro Mode.

Gyro Mode's endurance is not very impressive with its lack of NSK shield bearings, but its almost perfect circular form and the gyro gimmick itself gives Gyro Mode strong defensive abilities along with the fact that in battle, Gyro Mode will be able to absorb hits from other Beyblades because it is made entirely of plastic. In theory, the gyro gimmick comes into play as Gyro Mode loses its balance, yet is able to continue spinning for longer than other Beyblades would be able to with much of their balance lost. However, in reality, Gyro Mode itself is not competitively viable, perhaps due to the fact that it uses metal bearings instead of NSK shield bearings.

Gyro Mode's gimmick outside of battle relies on the three interchangeable tips that can be inserted into the top hole of the armor, to perform various tricks, such as spinning it upside down.

=== HMS AR Compatibility ===
Not all ARs are compatible with Gyro Mode, the following ARs do not work properly for this mode:

* Metal Saucer (Gaia Dragoon MS)
* Metal Spring (Einstein MS)
* Samurai Upper (Samurai Changer MS)
* Circle Upper (Death Gargoyle MS)
* DJ Spiker (Wyvern DJ) Spark Dragon (Thunder Dragon)
* Seagon Attacker (Sea Dragon)
* Upper Fox (Phantom Fox MS)
* Advance Attacker (Advance Striker)
* Advance Defenser (Advance Guardian)
* Advance Balancer (Advance Averazer)
* Advance Survivor (Advance Eterner)
* Upper Dragon (Dragoon MF)
* Devil Crusher (Bloody Devil MS)
* God Crusher (Shining God MS)

Of the ARs that are compatible, Wolborg MS's Wolf Crusher is the best choice for Gyro Mode due to its weight distribution which enhances the effect of the gyro gimmick.

==Running Shooter==
Included in this package is a grip called the Running Shooter. However, for it to function, you must already have an [[Customize Grip|HMS Customize Grip]]. The part that is detachable from the handle of the HMS Customize Grip is attached to the Running Shooter.

It is a very small grip that is molded to fit fingers. For shooting techniques that require the shooter to move quickly, it is often a better choice than HMS Customize Grip. However, if you need to hold the shooter still, HMS Customize Grip is still a better choice.

==Running Mode==
Round Shell MS’s gimmick is known as running mode; using the running shooter included in the package, it is possible to launch Round Shell MS vertically, making it roll like a tire.

To do this, you must remove the AR, [[Bit Protector]], and fasten the Running Protector in its place. With the Running Protector attached, you can turn Rubber Weight Core on its side put it into the special attachment on the running shooter. Running mode has absolutely no uses in any battle situations, and is not tournament legal.

==Overall==
Turtle Crusher does have some use, but [[Aero Knight MS]]'s Knight Crusher or the second mould of [[Death Gargoyle MS]]'s Circle Upper both work just as well or better. However, Rubber Weight Core does have some particularly good niche uses, and the Running Shooter is very valuable for [[Attack]]-type Beyblades. This set is a good addition to any Blader's collection.

==Bit-Protector: Riger Emblem==
The [[Bit Protector]] for it is the Riger Emblem. It is a third gen mold bit-protector. The sticker depicts a stylized motif of a [[Wikipedia:Liger|Liger]].

== Attack Ring: Slash Upper ==

* '''Weight:''' 18 grams

Slash Upper is the most useful part of Slash Riger MS. It is strong in not just one, but two types of Attack: [[Smash Attack]] and [[Upper Attack]]. The Metal Frame of Slash Upper has two steep Upper Attack slopes, both of which abruptly end with a blunt edge, giving it simultaneous Upper and Smash Attack in right spin. In left spin, Slash Upper loses its Upper Attack abilities, but retains its strong Smash Attack attributes in other areas; in the ABS Caul, along with the Metal Frame where an exposed piece of metal give it some Smash Attack in that direction.

Compared to Samurai Upper and Circle Upper, Slash Upper's attack range is in fact, smaller, but this should not be a detriment to its performance, especially in small stadiums like Tornado Balance Type S. However, one factor which could be considered a disadvantage in certain situations is its light weight compared to the other staple Attack based ARs. Two of the best ARs in the HMS series, Jiraiya Blade and Samurai Upper are both heavier by approximately four grams. Unless you are making a purely Smash Attack based custom, where weight is not of huge importance, generally, it would be a better idea to choose a heavier AR than Slash Upper. That being said, Slash Upper's versatility should also be considered when deciding on whether or not to use it.

=== Use in Upper Attack Customization ===
Slash Upper can be used to great effect in any Upper Attack based custom, with added Smash Attack.

* '''AR:''' Slash Upper ('''Slash Riger MS''')
* '''WD:''' CWD God Ring ([[Shining God MS]])
* '''RC:''' Metal Flat Core ([[Advance Striker]])

== Weight Disk: CWD Free Crusher ==

* '''Weight:''' 18 grams

CWD Free Crusher has a wide attack range, bigger than any other [[HMS]] AR or CWD. Its wide attack range can be attributed to the six sharp spikes surrounding its perimeter. CWD Free Crusher's intended purpose is to use its blunt spikes to [[Smash Attack]] the opposing Beyblade. However, because it is free-spinning it does more damage to the Beyblade it is being used on rather than the opponent's own. The fact that it is moving means that the attack points will always be moving when hitting the opposing Beyblade and will never make a severe enough blow. If it had been a fixed CWD rather than free-spinning, the Smash Attack would have been brutal, likely with extreme recoil. This CWD is not viable for any competitive situation, aside from one specialized customization, outlined below.

=== Use in Smash Attack Customization ===
There is an interesting trick you can perform with this RC. CWD Free Crusher is generally free-spinning so it cannot do any damage. However, by combining it with [[Samurai Changer MS]]'s Battle Change Core, the CWD plastic part of Battle Change Core will prevent the CWD Free Crusher from spinning. This combo has very high [[Smash Attack]], but also has high recoil. If it doesn't finish the battle almost immediately, it has very little chance to win.

* '''AR:''' Samurai Upper ([[Samurai Changer MS]])
* '''WD:''' CWD Free Crusher ('''Slash Riger MS''')
* '''RC:''' Battle Change Core (Samurai Changer MS)

== Running Core: Free Wing Core ==

:* '''Weight:''' 7 grams

Free Wing Core has two gimmicks. It has three foldable claws which hang down while not spinning, and float up due to inertia while spinning. Similar to CWD Free Crusher, Free Wing Core's claws also spin freely. These claws will more often than not, make next to no contact with the opposing Beyblade due to the massive height of the RC (to allow for the claws to hang down), which also makes it quite easy to knock off balance. Even if the claws somehow manage to make contact, they will only perform in a similarly ineffective way as CWD Free Crusher's spikes do. Free Wing Core has no use whatsoever.

==Overall==
Slash Riger MS, while it does have a very aesthetically pleasing design, contains a number of useless parts in its CWD and RC. What makes this Beyblade a worthy addition to any Bladers collection however is its third mold BP, Riger Emblem. The third mold [[Bit Protector | Bit Protectors]] were only released in five different [[HMS]] Beyblades. More important than this is its AR, Slash Upper. Slash Upper is a versatile AR which employs the use of Smash and [[Upper Attack]] at the same time to an effective degree. Slash Upper alone makes Slash Riger MS a great buy for any Beyblader looking to get away from the staple Upper and Smash ARs such as Samurai Upper and Jiraiya Blade.

==Trivia==
* "Riger" is a likely mistranslation of the Katakana, which can also be translated as "[[wikipedia:Liger|Liger]]", which is the offspring of a male lion and a female tiger.
* there is a possibility that Slash Riger MS and [[Round Shell MS]] were once Driger and Draciel MF prototypes.
